named-native-query.name: CubridGetAttrs
named-native-query.query: SELECT A.CLASS_NAME AS objNm , B.ATTR_NAME AS attrNm , B.COMMENT AS attrNmKr , CASE WHEN B.DATA_TYPE IN ('STRING', 'VARCHAR') THEN 'VARCHAR' WHEN B.DATA_TYPE IN ('SHORT', 'SMALLINT', 'INTEGER', 'BIGINT', 'NUMERIC', 'FLOAT', 'DOUBLE', 'MONETARY') THEN 'NUMERIC' WHEN B.DATA_TYPE LIKE 'DATETIME%' OR B.DATA_TYPE LIKE 'TIMESTAMP%' THEN 'TIMESTAMP' WHEN B.DATA_TYPE IN ('BLOB', 'BIT', 'BIT VARYING') THEN 'BLOB' ELSE B.DATA_TYPE END AS dataType , B.DATA_TYPE AS dbmsDataType , B.PREC AS dataLen , B.SCALE AS dataDecimalLen , CASE WHEN B.IS_NULLABLE = 'YES' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS nullableYn , CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DB_INDEX C, DB_INDEX_KEY D WHERE C.IS_PRIMARY_KEY = 'YES' AND C.OWNER_NAME = B.OWNER_NAME AND C.CLASS_NAME = B.CLASS_NAME AND D.OWNER_NAME = C.OWNER_NAME AND D.CLASS_NAME = C.CLASS_NAME AND D.INDEX_NAME = C.INDEX_NAME AND D.KEY_ATTR_NAME = B.ATTR_NAME) THEN 'Y' END AS pkYn , CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DB_INDEX E, DB_INDEX_KEY F WHERE E.IS_FOREIGN_KEY = 'YES' AND E.OWNER_NAME = B.OWNER_NAME AND E.CLASS_NAME = B.CLASS_NAME AND F.OWNER_NAME = E.OWNER_NAME AND F.CLASS_NAME = E.CLASS_NAME AND F.INDEX_NAME = E.INDEX_NAME AND F.KEY_ATTR_NAME = B.ATTR_NAME) THEN 'Y' END AS fkYn , B.DEFAULT_VALUE AS defaultVal , B.DEF_ORDER + 1 AS attrOrder FROM DB_CLASS A INNER JOIN DB_ATTRIBUTE B ON B.CLASS_NAME = A.CLASS_NAME AND B.OWNER_NAME = A.OWNER_NAME WHERE A.is_system_class = 'NO' AND A.CLASS_TYPE = 'CLASS' AND B.ATTR_TYPE = 'INSTANCE' AND UPPER(A.OWNER_NAME) = :owner ORDER BY objNm, attrOrder

named-native-query.name: CubridGetObjs
named-native-query.query: SELECT A.OWNER_NAME AS objOwner ,A.CLASS_NAME AS objNm ,A.COMMENT AS objNmKr ,count(B.ATTR_NAME) AS objAttrCnt ,'' AS objCretDt ,'' AS objUpdtDt ,'' AS tablespaceNm FROM DB_CLASS A, DB_ATTRIBUTE B WHERE A.CLASS_NAME = B.CLASS_NAME AND A.OWNER_NAME = B.OWNER_NAME AND B.ATTR_TYPE = 'INSTANCE' AND UPPER(A.OWNER_NAME) = :owner AND A.CLASS_TYPE = 'CLASS' AND A.is_system_class = 'NO' GROUP BY A.OWNER_NAME, A.CLASS_NAME ORDER BY objOwner, objNm

named-native-query.name: CubridGetIndexes
named-native-query.query: SELECT I.OWNER_NAME AS objOwner , I.CLASS_NAME AS tableNm , I.INDEX_NAME AS indexNm , CASE WHEN I.IS_REVERSE = 'YES' THEN 'REVERSE' ELSE 'BTREE' END AS indexType , CASE WHEN I.IS_UNIQUE = 'YES' THEN 'UNIQUE' ELSE 'NONUNIQUE' END AS uniqueness , NVL(K.KEY_ATTR_NAME, K.FUNC) AS columnNm , K.KEY_ORDER + 1 AS columnPos , K.ASC_DESC AS sortOrder , '' AS tablespaceNm FROM DB_INDEX I JOIN DB_INDEX_KEY K ON K.OWNER_NAME = I.OWNER_NAME AND K.CLASS_NAME = I.CLASS_NAME AND K.INDEX_NAME = I.INDEX_NAME WHERE UPPER(I.OWNER_NAME) = :owner ORDER BY tableNm, indexNm, columnPos

named-native-query.name: CubridGetConstraints
named-native-query.query: SELECT I.OWNER_NAME AS objOwner , I.CLASS_NAME AS tableNm , I.INDEX_NAME AS constraintNm , CASE WHEN I.IS_PRIMARY_KEY = 'YES' THEN 'P' WHEN I.IS_FOREIGN_KEY = 'YES' THEN 'R' ELSE 'U' END AS constraintType , K.KEY_ATTR_NAME AS columnNm , K.KEY_ORDER + 1 AS columnPos , NULL AS refOwner , NULL AS refTableNm , NULL AS refColumnNm , NULL AS deleteRule , 'ENABLED' AS status , NULL AS searchCondition FROM DB_INDEX I JOIN DB_INDEX_KEY K ON K.OWNER_NAME = I.OWNER_NAME AND K.CLASS_NAME = I.CLASS_NAME AND K.INDEX_NAME = I.INDEX_NAME WHERE UPPER(I.OWNER_NAME) = :owner AND (I.IS_PRIMARY_KEY = 'YES' OR I.IS_FOREIGN_KEY = 'YES' OR I.IS_UNIQUE = 'YES') ORDER BY tableNm, constraintType, constraintNm, columnPos

named-native-query.name: OracleGetAttrs
named-native-query.query: SELECT A.TABLE_NAME AS objNm, A.COLUMN_NAME AS attrNm, A.COL_CMT AS attrNmKr, CASE WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'VARCHAR2' or A.DATA_TYPE = 'NVARCHAR' THEN 'VARCHAR' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'NCHAR' THEN 'CHAR' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'FLOAT' THEN 'NUMERIC' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'NUMBER' THEN 'NUMERIC' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'LONG' or A.DATA_TYPE = 'NCLOB' THEN 'CLOB' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE = 'BFILE' THEN 'BLOB' WHEN A.DATA_TYPE like 'TIMESTAMP%' THEN 'TIMESTAMP' ELSE A.DATA_TYPE END AS dataType, A.DATA_TYPE AS dbmsDataType, A.LEN AS dataLen, A.DATA_SCALE AS dataDecimalLen, A.NULLABLE AS nullableYn, B.POS AS pkYn, C.FK_POS fkYn, A.DATA_DEFAULT AS defaultVal, A.COLUMN_ID AS attrOrder FROM (SELECT S1.OWNER , S1.TABLE_NAME, S3.COMMENTS AS TAB_CMT, S1.COLUMN_NAME, S2.COMMENTS AS COL_CMT, S1.DATA_TYPE, CASE WHEN S1.DATA_PRECISION IS NOT NULL THEN DATA_PRECISION ELSE S1.DATA_LENGTH END AS LEN, DATA_SCALE, NULLABLE, COLUMN_ID, DATA_DEFAULT FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS S1, ALL_COL_COMMENTS S2, ALL_TAB_COMMENTS S3 WHERE S1.OWNER = S2.OWNER AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S2.TABLE_NAME AND S1.COLUMN_NAME = S2.COLUMN_NAME AND S1.OWNER = S3.OWNER AND S3.TABLE_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S3.TABLE_NAME AND S1.TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT T.TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES T WHERE T.OWNER = S1.OWNER AND T.TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX')) AND S1.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' ) A, (SELECT T1.OWNER, T1.TABLE_NAME, T2.COLUMN_NAME, 'Y' AS POS FROM (SELECT OWNER, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM ALL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'P' )T1, (SELECT OWNER, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, POSITION FROM ALL_CONS_COLUMNS ) T2 WHERE T1.OWNER = T2.OWNER AND T1.TABLE_NAME = T2.TABLE_NAME AND T1.CONSTRAINT_NAME = T2.CONSTRAINT_NAME ) B, (SELECT DISTINCT T1.OWNER, T1.TABLE_NAME, T2.COLUMN_NAME, 'Y' AS FK_POS FROM (SELECT OWNER, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME FROM ALL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'R' )T1, (SELECT OWNER, TABLE_NAME, CONSTRAINT_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, POSITION FROM ALL_CONS_COLUMNS ) T2 WHERE T1.OWNER = T2.OWNER AND T1.TABLE_NAME = T2.TABLE_NAME AND T1.CONSTRAINT_NAME = T2.CONSTRAINT_NAME ) C WHERE A.OWNER = B.OWNER(+) AND A.TABLE_NAME = B.TABLE_NAME(+) AND A.COLUMN_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME(+) AND A.OWNER = C.OWNER(+) AND A.TABLE_NAME = C.TABLE_NAME(+) AND A.COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME(+) AND UPPER(A.OWNER) = :owner ORDER BY objNm, attrOrder

named-native-query.name: OracleGetObjs
named-native-query.query: SELECT distinct S1.OWNER as objOwner --OWNER명 ,S1.TABLE_NAME as objNm --영문테이블명 ,S2.COMMENTS as objNmKr --한글테이블명 ,(SELECT count(COLUMN_NAME) FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE OWNER = S1.OWNER AND TABLE_NAME = S1.TABLE_NAME) as objAttrCnt --테이블컬럼개수 ,to_char(S3.CREATED,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as objCretDt --등록일자 ,to_char(S3.LAST_DDL_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as objUpdtDt --수정일자 ,S1.TABLESPACE_NAME as tablespaceNm --테이블스페이스 FROM ALL_TABLES S1 ,ALL_TAB_COMMENTS S2 ,ALL_OBJECTS S3 WHERE 1=1 AND S1.OWNER = S2.OWNER AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S2.TABLE_NAME AND S1.OWNER = S3.OWNER AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S3.OBJECT_NAME AND S2.TABLE_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND S3.OBJECT_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND S1.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' AND S1.OWNER NOT IN ('SYS') AND S1.TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM' , 'SYSAUX') AND UPPER(S1.OWNER) = :owner -- Owner명 입력 ORDER BY objOwner, objNm

named-native-query.name: OracleGetIndexes
named-native-query.query: SELECT I.OWNER AS objOwner, I.TABLE_NAME AS tableNm, I.INDEX_NAME AS indexNm, I.INDEX_TYPE AS indexType, I.UNIQUENESS AS uniqueness, IC.COLUMN_NAME AS columnNm, IC.COLUMN_POSITION AS columnPos, IC.DESCEND AS sortOrder, I.TABLESPACE_NAME AS tablespaceNm FROM ALL_INDEXES I JOIN ALL_IND_COLUMNS IC ON I.OWNER = IC.INDEX_OWNER AND I.INDEX_NAME = IC.INDEX_NAME WHERE UPPER(I.OWNER) = :owner AND I.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' AND I.TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE OWNER = I.OWNER AND TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX')) ORDER BY I.TABLE_NAME, I.INDEX_NAME, IC.COLUMN_POSITION

named-native-query.name: OracleGetConstraints
named-native-query.query: SELECT C.OWNER AS objOwner, C.TABLE_NAME AS tableNm, C.CONSTRAINT_NAME AS constraintNm, C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE AS constraintType, CC.COLUMN_NAME AS columnNm, CC.POSITION AS columnPos, R.OWNER AS refOwner, R.TABLE_NAME AS refTableNm, RC.COLUMN_NAME AS refColumnNm, C.DELETE_RULE AS deleteRule, C.STATUS AS status, C.SEARCH_CONDITION AS searchCondition FROM ALL_CONSTRAINTS C JOIN ALL_CONS_COLUMNS CC ON C.OWNER = CC.OWNER AND C.CONSTRAINT_NAME = CC.CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN ALL_CONSTRAINTS R ON C.R_OWNER = R.OWNER AND C.R_CONSTRAINT_NAME = R.CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN ALL_CONS_COLUMNS RC ON R.OWNER = RC.OWNER AND R.CONSTRAINT_NAME = RC.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND CC.POSITION = RC.POSITION WHERE UPPER(C.OWNER) = :owner AND C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE IN ('P', 'R', 'U', 'C') AND C.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' AND C.TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE OWNER = C.OWNER AND TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX')) ORDER BY C.TABLE_NAME, C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE, C.CONSTRAINT_NAME, CC.POSITION

named-native-query.name: TiberoGetObjs
named-native-query.query: SELECT distinct S1.OWNER as objOwner ,S1.TABLE_NAME as objNm ,S2.COMMENTS as objNmKr ,(SELECT count(COLUMN_NAME) FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE OWNER = S1.OWNER AND TABLE_NAME = S1.TABLE_NAME) as objAttrCnt ,to_char(S3.CREATED,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as objCretDt ,to_char(S3.LAST_DDL_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as objUpdtDt ,S1.TABLESPACE_NAME as tablespaceNm FROM ALL_TABLES S1 ,ALL_TAB_COMMENTS S2 ,ALL_OBJECTS S3 WHERE 1=1 AND S1.OWNER = S2.OWNER AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S2.TABLE_NAME AND S1.OWNER = S3.OWNER AND S1.TABLE_NAME = S3.OBJECT_NAME AND S2.TABLE_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND S3.OBJECT_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND S1.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' AND S1.OWNER NOT IN ('SYS') AND S1.TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX','SYSSUB') AND UPPER(S1.OWNER) = :owner ORDER BY objOwner, objNm

named-native-query.name: TiberoGetIndexes
named-native-query.query: SELECT I.OWNER AS objOwner, I.TABLE_NAME AS tableNm, I.INDEX_NAME AS indexNm, I.INDEX_TYPE AS indexType, I.UNIQUENESS AS uniqueness, IC.COLUMN_NAME AS columnNm, IC.COLUMN_POSITION AS columnPos, IC.DESCEND AS sortOrder, I.TABLESPACE_NAME AS tablespaceNm FROM ALL_INDEXES I JOIN ALL_IND_COLUMNS IC ON I.OWNER = IC.INDEX_OWNER AND I.INDEX_NAME = IC.INDEX_NAME WHERE UPPER(I.OWNER) = :owner AND I.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' AND I.TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE OWNER = I.OWNER AND TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX','SYSSUB')) ORDER BY I.TABLE_NAME, I.INDEX_NAME, IC.COLUMN_POSITION

named-native-query.name: TiberoGetConstraints
named-native-query.query: SELECT C.OWNER AS objOwner, C.TABLE_NAME AS tableNm, C.CONSTRAINT_NAME AS constraintNm, C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE AS constraintType, CC.COLUMN_NAME AS columnNm, CC.POSITION AS columnPos, R.OWNER AS refOwner, R.TABLE_NAME AS refTableNm, RC.COLUMN_NAME AS refColumnNm, C.DELETE_RULE AS deleteRule, C.STATUS AS status, C.SEARCH_CONDITION AS searchCondition FROM ALL_CONSTRAINTS C JOIN ALL_CONS_COLUMNS CC ON C.OWNER = CC.OWNER AND C.CONSTRAINT_NAME = CC.CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN ALL_CONSTRAINTS R ON C.R_OWNER = R.OWNER AND C.R_CONSTRAINT_NAME = R.CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN ALL_CONS_COLUMNS RC ON R.OWNER = RC.OWNER AND R.CONSTRAINT_NAME = RC.CONSTRAINT_NAME AND CC.POSITION = RC.POSITION WHERE UPPER(C.OWNER) = :owner AND C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE IN ('P', 'R', 'U', 'C') AND C.TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEMP%' AND C.TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE OWNER = C.OWNER AND TABLESPACE_NAME NOT IN ('SYSTEM','SYSAUX','SYSSUB')) ORDER BY C.TABLE_NAME, C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE, C.CONSTRAINT_NAME, CC.POSITION

named-native-query.name: MariaDBGetAttrs
named-native-query.query: SELECT c.TABLE_NAME AS objNm ,c.COLUMN_NAME AS attrNm ,c.COLUMN_COMMENT AS attrNmKr ,CASE WHEN c.IS_NULLABLE = 'YES' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS nullableYn ,CASE WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('varchar', 'tinytext', 'text', 'mediumtext', 'longtext', 'enum', 'set') THEN 'VARCHAR' WHEN c.DATA_TYPE = 'char' THEN 'CHAR' WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('tinyint', 'smallint', 'mediumint', 'int', 'bigint', 'decimal', 'float', 'double') THEN 'NUMERIC' WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('datetime', 'timestamp') THEN 'TIMESTAMP' WHEN c.DATA_TYPE IN ('tinyblob', 'blob', 'mediumblob', 'longblob', 'binary', 'varbinary') THEN 'BLOB' ELSE UPPER(c.DATA_TYPE) END AS dataType ,c.DATA_TYPE AS dbmsDataType ,CASE WHEN c.NUMERIC_PRECISION IS NOT NULL THEN c.NUMERIC_PRECISION ELSE c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH END AS dataLen ,c.NUMERIC_SCALE AS dataDecimalLen ,CASE WHEN c.COLUMN_KEY = 'PRI' THEN 'Y' END AS pkYn ,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k WHERE k.TABLE_SCHEMA = c.TABLE_SCHEMA AND k.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME AND k.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME AND k.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Y' END AS fkYn ,c.COLUMN_DEFAULT AS defaultVal ,c.ORDINAL_POSITION AS attrOrder FROM information_schema.COLUMNS c JOIN information_schema.TABLES t ON t.TABLE_SCHEMA = c.TABLE_SCHEMA AND t.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME AND t.TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' WHERE upper(c.TABLE_SCHEMA) = :owner ORDER BY objNm, attrOrder

named-native-query.name: MariaDBGetObjs
named-native-query.query: SELECT S1.TABLE_SCHEMA AS objOwner , S1.TABLE_NAME AS objNm , S1.TABLE_COMMENT AS objNmKr , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS S2 WHERE S2.TABLE_SCHEMA = S1.TABLE_SCHEMA AND S2.TABLE_NAME = S1.TABLE_NAME) AS objAttrCnt , DATE_FORMAT(S1.CREATE_TIME, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS objCretDt , DATE_FORMAT(S1.UPDATE_TIME, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS objUpdtDt , '' AS tablespaceNm FROM information_schema.TABLES S1 WHERE upper(S1.TABLE_SCHEMA) = :owner AND S1.TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY objOwner, objNm

named-native-query.name: MariaDBGetIndexes
named-native-query.query: SELECT s.TABLE_SCHEMA AS objOwner , s.TABLE_NAME AS tableNm , s.INDEX_NAME AS indexNm , s.INDEX_TYPE AS indexType , CASE WHEN s.NON_UNIQUE = 0 THEN 'UNIQUE' ELSE 'NONUNIQUE' END AS uniqueness , s.COLUMN_NAME AS columnNm , s.SEQ_IN_INDEX AS columnPos , CASE WHEN s.COLLATION = 'D' THEN 'DESC' ELSE 'ASC' END AS sortOrder , '' AS tablespaceNm FROM information_schema.STATISTICS s JOIN information_schema.TABLES t ON t.TABLE_SCHEMA = s.TABLE_SCHEMA AND t.TABLE_NAME = s.TABLE_NAME AND t.TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE' WHERE upper(s.TABLE_SCHEMA) = :owner ORDER BY tableNm, indexNm, columnPos

named-native-query.name: MariaDBGetConstraints
named-native-query.query: SELECT tc.TABLE_SCHEMA AS objOwner , tc.TABLE_NAME AS tableNm , tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME AS constraintNm , CASE tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE WHEN 'PRIMARY KEY' THEN 'P' WHEN 'FOREIGN KEY' THEN 'R' WHEN 'UNIQUE' THEN 'U' WHEN 'CHECK' THEN 'C' END AS constraintType , k.COLUMN_NAME AS columnNm , COALESCE(k.ORDINAL_POSITION, 1) AS columnPos , k.REFERENCED_TABLE_SCHEMA AS refOwner , k.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME AS refTableNm , k.REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME AS refColumnNm , rc.DELETE_RULE AS deleteRule , 'ENABLED' AS status , cc.CHECK_CLAUSE AS searchCondition FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc LEFT JOIN information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k ON k.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND k.TABLE_NAME = tc.TABLE_NAME AND k.CONSTRAINT_NAME = tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN information_schema.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS rc ON rc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND rc.TABLE_NAME = tc.TABLE_NAME AND rc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME LEFT JOIN information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS cc ON cc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND cc.TABLE_NAME = tc.TABLE_NAME AND cc.CONSTRAINT_NAME = tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE upper(tc.TABLE_SCHEMA) = :owner ORDER BY tableNm, constraintType, constraintNm, columnPos

named-native-query.name: SQLServerGetObjs
named-native-query.query: SELECT s.name AS objOwner ,t.name AS objNm ,CAST(ep.value AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS objNmKr ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id = t.object_id) AS objAttrCnt ,FORMAT(t.create_date, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss') AS objCretDt ,FORMAT(t.modify_date, 'yyyyMMddHHmmss') AS objUpdtDt ,ISNULL(ds.name, '') AS tablespaceNm FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties ep ON ep.class = 1 AND ep.major_id = t.object_id AND ep.minor_id = 0 AND ep.name = 'MS_Description' LEFT JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id = t.object_id AND i.index_id IN (0, 1) LEFT JOIN sys.data_spaces ds ON ds.data_space_id = i.data_space_id WHERE t.is_ms_shipped = 0 AND UPPER(s.name) = :owner ORDER BY objOwner, objNm

named-native-query.name: SQLServerGetAttrs
named-native-query.query: SELECT t.name AS objNm ,c.name AS attrNm ,CAST(ep.value AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS attrNmKr ,CASE WHEN ty.name IN ('varchar', 'nvarchar', 'text', 'ntext', 'sysname') THEN 'VARCHAR' WHEN ty.name IN ('char', 'nchar') THEN 'CHAR' WHEN ty.name IN ('tinyint', 'smallint', 'int', 'bigint', 'decimal', 'numeric', 'float', 'real', 'money', 'smallmoney') THEN 'NUMERIC' WHEN ty.name IN ('datetime', 'datetime2', 'smalldatetime', 'datetimeoffset') THEN 'TIMESTAMP' WHEN ty.name IN ('binary', 'varbinary', 'image') THEN 'BLOB' ELSE UPPER(ty.name) END AS dataType ,ty.name AS dbmsDataType ,CASE WHEN c.max_length = -1 THEN NULL WHEN ty.name IN ('nvarchar', 'nchar') THEN c.max_length / 2 WHEN ty.name IN ('varchar', 'char', 'binary', 'varbinary') THEN c.max_length WHEN ty.name IN ('decimal', 'numeric', 'tinyint', 'smallint', 'int', 'bigint') THEN c.precision END AS dataLen ,CASE WHEN ty.name IN ('decimal', 'numeric') THEN c.scale END AS dataDecimalLen ,CASE WHEN c.is_nullable = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS nullableYn ,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes ix JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = ix.object_id AND ic.index_id = ix.index_id WHERE ix.object_id = c.object_id AND ix.is_primary_key = 1 AND ic.column_id = c.column_id) THEN 'Y' END AS pkYn ,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fc WHERE fc.parent_object_id = c.object_id AND fc.parent_column_id = c.column_id) THEN 'Y' END AS fkYn ,OBJECT_DEFINITION(c.default_object_id) AS defaultVal ,c.column_id AS attrOrder FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = c.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id = c.system_type_id AND ty.user_type_id = ty.system_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties ep ON ep.class = 1 AND ep.major_id = c.object_id AND ep.minor_id = c.column_id AND ep.name = 'MS_Description' WHERE t.is_ms_shipped = 0 AND UPPER(s.name) = :owner ORDER BY objNm, attrOrder

named-native-query.name: SQLServerGetIndexes
named-native-query.query: SELECT s.name AS objOwner ,t.name AS tableNm ,i.name AS indexNm ,i.type_desc AS indexType ,CASE WHEN i.is_unique = 1 THEN 'UNIQUE' ELSE 'NONUNIQUE' END AS uniqueness ,c.name AS columnNm ,ic.key_ordinal AS columnPos ,CASE WHEN ic.is_descending_key = 1 THEN 'DESC' ELSE 'ASC' END AS sortOrder ,ISNULL(ds.name, '') AS tablespaceNm FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = i.object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id AND ic.key_ordinal > 0 JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id LEFT JOIN sys.data_spaces ds ON ds.data_space_id = i.data_space_id WHERE t.is_ms_shipped = 0 AND i.type > 0 AND UPPER(s.name) = :owner ORDER BY tableNm, indexNm, columnPos

named-native-query.name: SQLServerGetConstraints
named-native-query.query: SELECT s.name AS objOwner, t.name AS tableNm, kc.name AS constraintNm ,CASE kc.type WHEN 'PK' THEN 'P' ELSE 'U' END AS constraintType ,c.name AS columnNm, ic.key_ordinal AS columnPos ,CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS refOwner, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS refTableNm, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(128)) AS refColumnNm ,CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(60)) AS deleteRule ,'ENABLED' AS status, CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS searchCondition FROM sys.key_constraints kc JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = kc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id = kc.parent_object_id AND ic.index_id = kc.unique_index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id WHERE UPPER(s.name) = :owner UNION ALL SELECT s.name, t.name, fk.name, 'R' ,c.name, fkc.constraint_column_id ,rs.name, rt.name, rc.name ,REPLACE(fk.delete_referential_action_desc, '_', ' ') ,CASE WHEN fk.is_disabled = 1 THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE 'ENABLED' END, NULL FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = fk.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id AND c.column_id = fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id = rt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id = fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE UPPER(s.name) = :owner UNION ALL SELECT s.name, t.name, cc.name, 'C' ,c.name, 1 ,NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL ,CASE WHEN cc.is_disabled = 1 THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE 'ENABLED' END, cc.definition FROM sys.check_constraints cc JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id = cc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = cc.parent_object_id AND c.column_id = cc.parent_column_id WHERE UPPER(s.name) = :owner ORDER BY tableNm, constraintType, constraintNm, columnPos

named-native-query.name: PostgreSQLGetObjs
named-native-query.query: SELECT n.nspname AS objOwner ,c.relname AS objNm ,obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class') AS objNmKr ,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS objAttrCnt ,NULL AS objCretDt ,NULL AS objUpdtDt ,COALESCE(t.spcname, '') AS tablespaceNm FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_tablespace t ON t.oid = c.reltablespace WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast') AND lower(n.nspname) = lower(:owner) ORDER BY objOwner, objNm

named-native-query.name: PostgreSQLGetAttrs
named-native-query.query: SELECT c.relname AS objNm ,a.attname AS attrNm ,col_description(c.oid, a.attnum) AS attrNmKr ,CASE WHEN t.typname IN ('varchar','text','name') THEN 'VARCHAR' WHEN t.typname IN ('bpchar','char') THEN 'CHAR' WHEN t.typname IN ('int2','int4','int8','numeric','float4','float8') THEN 'NUMERIC' WHEN t.typname IN ('timestamp','timestamptz') THEN 'TIMESTAMP' WHEN t.typname = 'date' THEN 'DATE' WHEN t.typname IN ('bytea') THEN 'BLOB' ELSE upper(t.typname) END AS dataType ,format_type(a.atttypid, NULL) AS dbmsDataType ,CASE WHEN t.typname IN ('varchar','bpchar','char') AND a.atttypmod > 4 THEN a.atttypmod - 4 WHEN t.typname = 'numeric' AND a.atttypmod > 4 THEN ((a.atttypmod - 4) >> 16) & 65535 ELSE NULL END AS dataLen ,CASE WHEN t.typname = 'numeric' AND a.atttypmod > 4 THEN (a.atttypmod - 4) & 65535 ELSE NULL END AS dataDecimalLen ,CASE WHEN a.attnotnull THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS nullableYn ,CASE WHEN pk.attnum IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS pkYn ,CASE WHEN fk.attnum IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' END AS fkYn ,pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) AS defaultVal ,a.attnum AS attrOrder FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid AND c.relkind = 'r' JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = a.atttypid LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = c.oid AND d.adnum = a.attnum LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.attnum FROM pg_constraint pc WHERE pc.conrelid = c.oid AND pc.contype = 'p' AND a.attnum = ANY(pc.conkey) LIMIT 1 ) pk ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.attnum FROM pg_constraint fc WHERE fc.conrelid = c.oid AND fc.contype = 'f' AND a.attnum = ANY(fc.conkey) LIMIT 1 ) fk ON TRUE WHERE a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast') AND lower(n.nspname) = lower(:owner) ORDER BY objNm, attrOrder

named-native-query.name: PostgreSQLGetIndexes
named-native-query.query: SELECT n.nspname AS objOwner ,t.relname AS tableNm ,i.relname AS indexNm ,am.amname AS indexType ,CASE WHEN ix.indisunique THEN 'UNIQUE' ELSE 'NONUNIQUE' END AS uniqueness ,a.attname AS columnNm ,k.ord AS columnPos ,CASE WHEN ix.indoption[k.ord - 1] & 1 = 1 THEN 'DESC' ELSE 'ASC' END AS sortOrder ,COALESCE(ts.spcname, '') AS tablespaceNm FROM pg_index ix JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = ix.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = ix.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam LEFT JOIN pg_tablespace ts ON ts.oid = i.reltablespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ix.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = t.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum WHERE t.relkind = 'r' AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast') AND lower(n.nspname) = lower(:owner) ORDER BY tableNm, indexNm, columnPos

named-native-query.name: PostgreSQLGetConstraints
named-native-query.query: SELECT n.nspname AS objOwner ,t.relname AS tableNm ,c.conname AS constraintNm ,CASE c.contype WHEN 'p' THEN 'P' WHEN 'f' THEN 'R' WHEN 'u' THEN 'U' WHEN 'c' THEN 'C' END AS constraintType ,a.attname AS columnNm ,k.ord AS columnPos ,rn.nspname AS refOwner ,rt.relname AS refTableNm ,ra.attname AS refColumnNm ,CASE c.confdeltype WHEN 'a' THEN 'NO ACTION' WHEN 'r' THEN 'RESTRICT' WHEN 'c' THEN 'CASCADE' WHEN 'n' THEN 'SET NULL' WHEN 'd' THEN 'SET DEFAULT' END AS deleteRule ,CASE WHEN c.convalidated THEN 'ENABLED' ELSE 'DISABLED' END AS status ,pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS searchCondition FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = t.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum LEFT JOIN pg_class rt ON rt.oid = c.confrelid LEFT JOIN pg_namespace rn ON rn.oid = rt.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attribute ra ON ra.attrelid = c.confrelid AND ra.attnum = c.confkey[k.ord] WHERE t.relkind = 'r' AND c.contype IN ('p','f','u','c') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema', 'pg_toast') AND lower(n.nspname) = lower(:owner) ORDER BY tableNm, constraintType, constraintNm, columnPos
